kept.title: ask-gate PREDICT thresholds are concrete shipped defaults in lib/ask-gate.js
kept.summary: The ask-vs-predict gate ships DEFAULTS = { cosThreshold:0.50, gapThreshold:0.25, marginThreshold:0.08, requireEmpirical:true, localityThreshold:2 }. A recalled preference note must clear cosine 0.50 AND (gap 0.25 OR a sharp standalone margin 0.08), be empirical (not bare-topical), and read project-local (>=2 of 4 locality cats) before request_guidance auto-resolves instead of asking. These mirror context-gate's calibration.

kept.title: Five hard-override categories ALWAYS escalate regardless of preference match
kept.summary: lib/ask-gate.js OVERRIDE_MARKERS hard-overrides prediction for irreversible (delete/drop/force-push/rm -rf/reset --hard/truncate), outward (publish/deploy/email/merge to main/open a PR/customer/prod), highImpact (payment/refund/credential/api-key/billing/security), scopeExpansion, and repeatedFailure. A confident preference note CANNOT license these — the keyword set is deliberately broad because a false override (asking needlessly) is cheap while a missed override (predicting an irreversible action) is the expensive failure.

kept.title: Semantic matching uses a LOCAL 384-dim Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sidecar, null-safe to lexical/ASK
kept.summary: All embeddings (notes, preferences, context-gate, ask-gate) are 384-float vectors from the local Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 transformers.js model run via an embed-server sidecar. embed(text) returns null while the sidecar is loading or on error; every semantic path is null-safe and falls back to lexical scoring, which for the ask-gate means defaulting to ASK rather than predicting.

kept.title: bench/specs/*.md are frozen synthetic benchmark prompts, NOT system documentation
kept.summary: Files like graph-dependent.md, v4-hard.md, context-rich.md, greenfield.md each open 'This is a fixed benchmark prompt. Implement exactly what is described below' and instruct an agent to build throwaway exercises (bench/sandbox/resolve-owner.js, parse-duration.js, task-tokens.js). They read like authoritative specs but describe eval tasks, not zonoid's actual behavior — do not treat their constraints (CommonJS exports, 'N passed 0 failed', file-scope limits) as project conventions.
